description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's ref name validation and handling, particularly focusing on invalid or badly formatted ref names, their creation, deletion, renaming, and error handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expecting certain commands to succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting certain commands to fail.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the executed command fails.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_ref_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific ref exists.

methods.name: test_ref_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specific ref is missing.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in the output.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Used to invoke custom or internal git testing utilities.
